item.description:
Flow, in beta. A steady wash of surf with a gentle beat under your work — headphones on. It runs until you switch it off, and it steps back a little while you dictate so you can hear yourself. Its switch sits next to Breathe on the front page.

Prompt and Draft never hand back raw text. When a rewrite would have changed your meaning and is refused, you now get Clean's pass instead of the bare transcript — and a short dictation can no longer be cut down to a single word.

Settings are one line each. Every setting is a single line with its switch; click the line to open its explanation and controls, one at a time. Nothing to scroll.
